# ARCH Revenues — Outbound Acquisition Systems for Agencies

ARCH Revenues is a specialized done-for-you outbound acquisition service for founder-led marketing and development agencies. Founded and operated by Shivam Sharma, based in Hyderabad, India.

## Core Offerings
- Done-for-you cold email and LinkedIn multi-channel outbound systems.
- ICP (Ideal Customer Profile) definition, B2B lead list building using Apollo (up to 300 target accounts per month), and AI-driven personalization.
- Infrastructure setup: 3 dedicated sending domains, Google Workspace inboxes, SPF, DKIM, DMARC configuration, domain rotation, and 14-day inbox warmup.
- Response handling (positive, negative, unsubscribe) managed within 4 business hours.
- Weekly Monday reporting tracking opens, replies, and booked qualified demos.

## Target Audience
- Founder-led marketing agencies, dev agencies, and software consultancies.
- Agencies primarily serving clients in the US, UK, Australia, and Canada.
- Founders who need consistent qualified sales calls (5-12 demos/month) without relying solely on referrals or hiring a full-time internal SDR team.

## Performance Pilot & Pricing
- Founding Client Rate (Performance Pilot): $499 one-time setup fee + $1,499/month flat retainer (locked for 90 days, 3 spots only).
- Standard Rate: Moves to $4,000/month after the first 3 founding client spots are filled.
- Performance Guarantee: If we book fewer than 5 qualified demos in any month, that month's retainer is fully refunded. Setup fee is non-refundable.
- Case Study Trade-off: In exchange for the discounted $1,499/mo rate, clients agree to be featured as a public case study once 5 qualified meetings are booked.
- Flexibility: Cancel anytime after the initial 30 days. No long-term annual contracts.

## Free AI Tools & Resources
- AI Cold Email Generator: https://www.archrevenues.com/tools/email-generator (Free interactive tool that analyzes a prospect's website and generates tailored cold emails).
- ICP Audit Worksheet: https://www.archrevenues.com/audit (Self-serve audit to define and validate your target client profile).
